## History

Martin was hired to work at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) a year prior to the death of [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). During his time there, he experienced the loss of four cows, including one that died around the time of Matthew's sudden collapse following the Abbey Bank failure. Later, he locked up the family's actual cow, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), in the barnyard, which inadvertently led [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to mistake Mr. Harrison's cow for her own and sell it.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--martin.md)

Martin works as a hired hand under [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). He performs various agricultural tasks around the farm, such as tending to the livestock and assisting with domestic errands like milking and driving cattle. His employment provides practical labor to help [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) manage the property.

- Serves under  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
